The launcher entry is `statechart.js`. The package ships that file beside `statechart.ts` because Pi runs the script on Node, not Bun's TypeScript loader.
Node spawns the worker with `--single-threaded` so V8 does not deadlock compiling the bundled worker, and the worker path is `worker.js`. Bun keeps `process.execArgv`.
Tests expect the `.js` entry, realpath the temp dir so macOS `/var` links do not break the launcher, and ignore ENOENT while the command replaces draft trees.
